---
title: "Trimmed glide"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

AeroBuildup optimization of a symmetric foam glider for minimum sink rate, modeling the foam as flat plates with fixed thickness and density.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Specified

1. **Optimisation objective: minimum sink rate** — Determines the cost function.
2. **Design variables: chords, stations, ballast** — Defines the design space.
3. **Static margin: 10%** — Sets stability requirement.
4. Solve budget `{python} f"{solve_budget():.0f}"` s, the notebook default.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Assumed

1. **Tail geometry: 100x30mm**, sensible fixed size.
2. **Tail incidence: Optimized**, required to trim symmetric foil.
:::
